customer_question: When does registration proceed after SIG confirms payment receipt?
question_variants: How soon after SIG payment confirmation can we proceed with the product registration?
SIG sent a payment receipt notification. What happens next and when?
actual_issue: Internal Allion coordination: confirming the timing between SIG payment receipt confirmation and the actual registration proxy work.
plain_english_explanation: Once SIG confirms payment received (issues the Receipt Number / RN), the proxy registrant can proceed with registration the next business day. The RN is the key that unlocks the registration portal's submission step.
consultant_answer: Registration can proceed the business day after SIG's payment receipt (RN issuance) is confirmed. No additional waiting is required after the RN is received.
decision_logic: The RN is the gate for SIG portal submission. Once the RN is in hand, registration work — if already prepared in parallel — can be completed the following business day.
final_recommendation: Prepare all registration content (ICS, test reports, TCW numbers, product details) in parallel with the payment process so that registration can be completed immediately after the RN is received.
risk_if_done_wrong: Waiting until after the RN is received to begin preparing registration content adds unnecessary days to the timeline.
